fields.Q01–Q12: literal integers 1–5 or literal NA; no missing-value replacement

fields.active_elapsed_s: active task seconds, excluding paused intervals; not video seconds
fields.participant_id: software endpoint P1/P2; use audited mapping, not research PID inference
fields.round_id: software attempt, distinct from research R01–R04
fields.manipulation_id: pair accepted grab and release within round

fields.source_file: normalized historical original-file locator; recomputed table uses repository relative path

geometry_from_backup.json.geometry: S1–S7; each has name, points (Nx3 stored local vertices), scale (accumulated uniform ancestor scale)
geometry_from_backup.json.limit: Saved backup, not binary proof of recording APK.

frame_provenance.time: requested/actual media time separate from reported event anchors
frame_provenance.crop_box: left, upper, right, lower in original pixel coordinates where supplied
frame_provenance.operation: rectangular crop only; no image synthesis or retouching
